collection.title: Audi A6 Saloon 1994 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1994 to 1997 version of an Audi A6 Saloon requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
